gizmo.title: Ọnọdụ nwere alaka
gizmo.description: Akụkọ ebe nhọrọ ọ bụla na-eduga n'ihe nkiri na njedebe dị iche. Ndị mmụta nwere ike ịlaghachi azụ ma nwaa ụzọ ndị ọzọ; njedebe eruru na-ekpebi akara.

configure.title: Aha
configure.description: Aha ọnọdụ ahụ, e gosiri n'isi ya.

configure.title: Ihe nkiri mmalite
configure.description: Id ihe nkiri ndị mmụta na-amalite na ya. Hapụ ya efu ka ịmalite n'ihe nkiri mbụ.

advanced.title: Agba ntụpọ
advanced.description: Agba nhọrọ maka akara isi, bọtịnụ na ọnụ nhọrọ.
